create_presidio_guardrail: create a Presidio PII masking guardrail instance with analyzer and anonymizer API bases and PII entity config
check_pii_text: check a text string for PII entities using the Presidio analyzer and anonymizer endpoints
unmask_pii_tokens: unmask PII tokens in a string by replacing numbered tokens with their original text values
process_response_for_pii: process a ModelResponse to unmask or mask PII in content, tool calls, and function arguments
apply_guardrail_text: apply the Presidio guardrail to a list of input texts, masking or unmasking based on input type
